svg.aria-label: poc-spec-driven-builder: Proves an idea works, tests before code. Research, a spec and a full test matrix come before any implementation. Steps: Research, best practice for the stack; Spec, an SRS with success criteria; Ticket, issue filed, branch cut; Tests, a matrix for every requirement; Build, until the tests pass; Ship, report, push, open the PR. Output: a PR that proves it, and what a full build would still need.
